findings.evidence: src/app/register/page.tsx lines 40-44: on auto-login failure the code does `setErr("Registered, but login failed. Try logging in."); router.push("/login"); return;` - it immediately navigates away to /login rather than staying on the register page to show the inline message.
findings.locationHint: **Expected Result:** Account is created and the user is authenticated and redirected to `/plans`. On registration failure or auto-login failure, an inline error message is shown (`src/app/register/page.tsx`).
findings.message: On auto-login failure the code does not just show an inline error and stay on /register; it also immediately calls router.push("/login"), redirecting the user away. The doc's Expected Result only says an inline error message is shown, omitting the redirect to /login on this path.
